en.setting.batch-size.label: Batch size
en.setting.batch-size.description: A NUMBER setting between 1 and 50 (test of the Module settings card).
en.setting.push-mode.label: Push mode
en.setting.push-mode.description: An ENUM setting: auto, manual or off (test of the Module settings card).
en.setting.verbose.label: Verbose answers
en.setting.verbose.description: A BOOLEAN setting (test of the Module settings card).

ro.setting.batch-size.description: O setare NUMBER între 1 și 50 (testul cardului Module settings).
ro.setting.push-mode.label: Modul de trimitere

ro.setting.verbose.label: Răspunsuri detaliate
